 More 2027 Medicare Advantage questions answered
 By Jim Sellers – Special to Salem Reporter 
 November 13, 2026 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X (Twitter) 
 Share on Pinterest 
 Share on LinkedIn 
 2027 Medicare Advantage (MA) and drug insurance plans have mixed news for Medicare beneficiaries: Those in the Salem area will still have a robust number of zero-premium MA plans, and, although the number of drugs plans has been trimmed, four plans still have monthly premiums below $10. Yet supplemental benefits that Medicare doesn’t cover are reduced, and the federal cap on annual drug costs will rise by $300 (14 percent) to $2,400.
